sources.document: Rider Perpetual Troubleshooters Manual XII, Philco
sources.source_relation: Reproduces the Philco schematic; a clearer print, not independent physical continuity evidence.

graph_claims_under_review.reason: In both reproduced drawings the left #13 resistor lead appears at the lower right #10 winding conductor and lower first-IF primary conductor. The 7B7 control-grid lead enters the upper first-IF secondary. The previous equality to the 7B7 grid requires a fresh crossing-by-crossing trace.
The right #13 resistor lead passes beneath several vertical conductors. Its return assignment must be rechecked before the entire #13 branch is certified.
The secondary cold end and adjacent conductor crossings require independent rechecking as part of the same path.

drawing_observation: The lower right #10 winding conductor appears to meet the lower first-IF primary and the left #13 resistor lead. This is an observation for continuity review, not a newly certified graph membership.
required_evidence: A legible independent schematic annotation or continuity measurements on an original PT-42/PT-44 chassis from both #10 winding ends through #12 primary/secondary and both #13 resistor leads, with the set unplugged.
policy: Do not treat the v0.40 IF return membership assertions as accepted gate-closure evidence until the conflicting path is resolved. Retain existing graph only as provisional legacy data pending a coherent correction of the whole conductor group.
